svg.title: The main axis on the grid, before and after the fit
svg.desc: Top view of the main axis in five cubes. With the distances of the Zemax file two cartridges reach into the end frames; after the fit all are inside.
svg.text: The main axis on the grid: before and after the fit
Top view, to scale. Hatched: the 7.9 mm at each end of a cube where no insert fits. Orange ticks: the twelve joint planes.
Distances of the Zemax file, dichroic face on the centre of cube (1, 0): two cartridges do not fit
After the fit: three optics moved, all in free gaps; the three locked distances are untouched
focusing lens, slit, collimator: one block
(two locked distances between them); it stays
objective → dichroic 30 → 34.1 mm; dichroic → edge filter 48.2 → 41.4; edge filter → window 18.5 → 14.4; dichroic → focusing lens stays 86.7 mm.
